title: cohort-gated-shadow-quarantine-orchestrator-for-safe-ab-experiments
author: Priya Khanna
release_notes: Adds a cohort-gated shadow quarantine controller and telemetry hooks to allow safe A/B tests and shadow traffic quarantining when regressions are detected. No public API change; opt-in via rollout config.
commits: f3b2c9e: add core quarantine controller and state machine
a7d4b22: integrate controller with rollout scheduler and API layer
c91a0f1: telemetry: emit quarantine events and cohort metrics
d2e5a8b: e2e tests for cohort gating and rollback paths
b4f7c33: docs: rollout config examples and migration guide
e1f3d44: flake fix in scheduler unit test
description: Context: We need a safe pattern for running A/B experiments and shadow traffic in production while automatically quarantining cohorts when regressions are detected by quality or latency signals. Motivation: ad-hoc shadowing created operational toil—on-call pages and noisy postmortems. This PR introduces a cohort-gated shadow quarantine orchestrator that detects per-cohort regressions, isolates shadow traffic into a quarantine lane, and automates rollback and notification flows. Design summary: - Cohort gating: rollouts can declare cohort selectors (user_id hash ranges, percentage buckets, request attributes). - Shadow quarantine lane: when metrics breach a configured threshold, matching cohort traffic is mirrored into an isolated quarantine pool rather than being routed to the primary candidate. Quarantine preserves request/response payloads for replay and offline debugging. - Safety gates: statistical and deterministic gates (SLO regression %, p-value threshold, upstream error increase). - Telemetry & audit: emits quarantine_open/quarantine_close events, cohort-level deltas (latency/quality/error), and a quarantine_reason field for forensic search. - Rollback automation: if quarantine persists beyond a configurable ttl or regression worsens, the orchestrator triggers a rollback to the previous stable model and closes the quarantine. Rollback is logged and emits an incident draft to the linear workspace (via ENG integration). Implementation highlights: - quarantine_controller.go implements a state machine: Idle -> Probing -> Quarantined -> RollbackPending -> Closed. - scheduler_integration adds backpressure-safe scheduling to the quarantine pool and keeps KV cache warm for candidate variants. - config_schema.go extends rollout spec: quarantine:{enabled, gates, ttl_seconds, sample_rate, mirror_ratio, notify_linear}. - Handlers expose a /rollouts/{id}/quarantine API to view state and perform manual interventions (force-close/open/rollback). - Telemetry: added protobufs and metric tags to correlate quarantine events with model versions and cohort ids. Testing & CI: - Unit tests for state transitions and gate evaluations. - e2e test that runs a synthetic cohort with injected latency and quality regression and validates quarantine opening, replay capture, and automated rollback. - Initial CI run had a flakey scheduler test; we fixed a timing assumption (see commit e1f3d44). Checks summary: - build: pass - unit-tests: pass (all rollout-controller tests) - e2e: pass (CI synthetic harness) - lint: pass - integration: pass (limited matrix) Backwards compatibility & migration: - Config is opt-in; existing rollouts are unaffected. - A migration script is provided to add defaults for older rollout specs if teams opt into quarantine by updating helm values. Operational runbook (docs/rollouts/cohort_quarantine.md): - How to enable for a rollout - Interpreting quarantine events and telemetry dashboards - Manual vs automated rollback flows - Recommended gates for common workloads Known limitations and future work: - Replay storage currently uses short-lived BLOB retention; plan to add configurable retention and replay export. - Statistical gates use a simplified delta test—will introduce more robust A/B analytics in a follow-up. Review summary and actions: - Lina requested clearer naming in the API and a small schema change to make notify_linear optional; addressed in commit c91a0f1 and docs. - Omar requested explicit tracing for replicated requests—added tracing tags and a short doc snippet. - Evan spotted race condition in transition from Probing->Quarantined under high concurrency; fixed by atomic state updates and added coverage (commit e1f3d44). Merge: squash merge after approvals.
